name: fix_go_mutex_copy
description: Fixes value receivers that copy a mutex, leaving the map unprotected
prompts: KVStore in store.go uses VALUE receivers on methods that lock its sync.Mutex - each call copies the struct (go vet: 'passes lock by value'), so every goroutine locks its own private copy and the underlying map has no protection at all. Fix store.go by making the receivers pointer receivers so the one real mutex guards the map. Behavior is unchanged; `go vet` must be clean and concurrent use race-free.
